sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.70 Dev

  • Settings controls: Remaining true on/off settings now use MV toggle switches instead of checkbox-style controls.
  • Speed dial: The main floating gear now opens Settings, and the Variable Panel is available as its own secondary action.
  • Grade A filters: Media Studio now uses a richer filter surface with condition counts while still combining with collection, dynamic folder, type, sort, and search.
  • List metadata: List view can show or hide extra metadata columns and scroll horizontally when needed.
  • UI polish: Select labels, checkbox ticks, toggle labels, bento sizing, hover-preview placement, Add to Collection cancel behavior, Dynamic-folder spacing, and MV-styled tooltips were tightened.

v1.3.69 Dev

  • External folder sync: Media Studio now includes a manual external folder-plugin sync action for teams keeping their old folder plugin installed.
  • Grade A filtering: Added media-quality filters for missing alt text, large files, small images, landscape, portrait, and square media; these combine with collection, dynamic folder, type, sort, and search filters.
  • Bento view: Reworked bento into a natural-proportion masonry layout so mixed landscape, portrait, square, SVG, and font files pack more cleanly.
  • Selection and drag: Checkbox-to-checkbox Shift range selection is fixed, and selected-media drags now show thumbnails/icons plus count close to the cursor.
  • UI polish: External source tooltips, MV toggles, convert controls, hover previews, Add to Collection dialogs, Dynamic folders, checkbox ticks, and Media Studio documentation were tightened.

v1.3.68 Dev

  • Media Studio polish: External folder source pills now render a single unclipped MV tooltip, use a calmer icon, and sit after the folder count.
  • Hover previews: Larger previews now size from the media ratio, clamp inside the viewport, and avoid sitting directly over the hovered card where possible.
  • Bento view: Bento cards now preserve natural media proportions with fit-mode rendering instead of behaving like square grid tiles.
  • Selection and drag: Checkbox Shift-range selection is more reliable, media drag ghosts stay close to the cursor, and file-drop overlays are less flickery.
  • UI cleanup: Toggles, checkmarks, conversion controls, sidebar controls, sticky details headers, and Media Studio documentation were tightened.
